paragraphs: R. Simon said: R. Yehoshua ben Levi said, Bereshit Rabbah 4, 10, 39; Vayikra Rabbah 1, 34; Bamidbar Rabbah 4, 12; Devarim Rabbah 10. In R. Natan's name, Vayikra Rabbah 10; in R. Shimon ben Ḥalafta's name, beginning of Shir HaShirim Rabbah.
